verbs.note: Irregular in the present (soy, eres...), the imperfect (era, eras...) and the preterite (fui, fuiste...).

verbs.en: to enter, go in, come in
verbs.note: Note: This is an intransitive verb and does not take a direct object; to enter a place, use the preposition en or a: ¿Quién entró en la casa? = Who entered the house?

verbs.en: to leave, abandon; to let, allow
verbs.note: Dejar is also used with the presposition de plus an infinitive to mean to stop doing something: Dejé de fumar = I stopped smoking.

verbs.en: to arrive, come, reach; to bring up, bring over; to gather together
verbs.note: Spelling change: g > gu before e.
Stem change: o > ue when stressed. Note: Encontrarse = to be found, to be located; encontarse con = to meet, run into, bump into.

verbs.en: to save, rescue; to except, exclude
verbs.note: Note: Salvar is a transitive verb meaning to save such things as someone's life; for to save money or to avoid problems or danger see ahorrar; for to save or conserve resources see conservar.
Irregular forms: oigo, oiga, oigas, etc. An unstressed i between vowels becomes y: oye, oyeron, oyendo, etc. Past participle: oído. vosotros command: oíd.
Spelling change: c > qu before e.
Irregular in the present (me voy, te vas...), the present subjunctive (me vaya...) and the preterite (me fui...).
Note that escuchar means to listen to, so that the preposition to (a) is not needed afterwards: Escucho la canción = I 'm listening to the song.
Note: This verb can mean both to stop (somebody/something) or to come to a stop. Parar de (hacer algo) = to stop (doing something).

verbs.en: to stay, remain, be left; to be (indicating location)
verbs.note: Example: Quedamos allí dos días = We stayed there two days. It may also be used in a gustar-type construction: No nos queda mucho dinero = We don't have much money left. The reflexive form quedarse also means to stay but often indicates an intentional staying behind.
An unstressed i between vowels becomes y: leyó, leyeron, leyendo, etc. Past participle: leído.
Stem change: e > ie. Irregular forms: mantengo, mantenga, mantengas, etc. Irregular future & conditional stem: mantendr-. Irregular preterite stem: mantuv-. Irregular tú command: mantén.

Note: When used in the present tense, acabar de + infinitive = to (have) just (done something): acaban de llegar = they (have) just arrived; when used in the imperfect in this construction, it means had just: acababan de llegar = they had just arrived.
Irregular past participle: abierto.
Irregular past participle: escrito.

Change: i > í when the stem is stressed.
Stem change: o > ue when stressed. Note: For try in the sense of to attempt, use tratar de or intentar.

verbs.note: Irregular forms: traigo, traiga, traigas, etc. Irregular preterite stem: traj-. The past participle has a written accent: traído. An unstressed i between vowels becomes y: trayendo.

verbs.en: to stop; to hold up, delay; to arrest, detain
